import os
import pandas as pd
import numpy as np
from sklearn.metrics import accuracy_score
from tensorflow.keras.preprocessing.text import Tokenizer
from tensorflow.keras.preprocessing.sequence import pad_sequences
from tensorflow.keras.models import Sequential
from tensorflow.keras.layers import (
    Embedding,
    Bidirectional,
    LSTM,
    Dense,
    Flatten,
    Dropout,
)
from tensorflow.keras.utils import to_categorical

# Load data
train = pd.read_csv("input/ru_train.csv")
test = pd.read_csv("input/ru_test_2.csv")

# Create validation set (hold-out split, not used for training)
val_size = 100000
validation = train.iloc[:val_size].copy()
train_data = train.iloc[val_size:].copy()

# Prepare features and labels
token_list = list(train["before"].unique())
vocab_size = len(token_list) + 1  # +1 for unknown
max_len = 200  # Maximum sentence length

tokenizer = Tokenizer(num_words=vocab_size)
tokenizer.fit_on_texts(train["before"])


def encode_text(text):
    return tokenizer.texts_to_sequences([text])[0]


X_val = [encode_text(t) for t in validation["before"]]
y_val = validation["after"]
X_train = [encode_text(t) for t in train_data["before"]]
y_train = train_data["after"]

X_val_pad = pad_sequences(X_val, maxlen=max_len)
X_train_pad = pad_sequences(X_train, maxlen=max_len)

y_val_cat = to_categorical(y_val.astype(str))
y_train_cat = to_categorical(y_train.astype(str))

model = Sequential(
    [
        Embedding(input_dim=vocab_size, output_dim=128, input_length=max_len),
        Bidirectional(LSTM(128)),
        Dropout(0.3),
        Dense(vocab_size, activation="softmax"),
    ]
)

model.compile(optimizer="adam", loss="categorical_crossentropy", metrics=["accuracy"])

model.fit(
    X_train_pad, y_train_cat, epochs=10, batch_size=512, validation_split=0.2, verbose=0
)

# Validate on holdout set
val_loss, val_acc = model.evaluate(X_val_pad, y_val_cat, verbose=0)
print(f"Validation Accuracy: {val_acc:.4f}")

# Generate predictions on test set
test_encoded = [encode_text(t) for t in test["before"]]
test_encoded_pad = pad_sequences(test_encoded, maxlen=max_len)
predictions = model.predict(test_encoded_pad, verbose=0)

# Create submission dataframe
submission_df = pd.DataFrame(predictions)
submission_df.columns = ["prob_pred"]
for i in range(len(submission_df)):
    if submission_df["prob_pred"][i].argmax() < len(tokenizer.word_index.keys()):
        pred = tokenizer.text_from_sequence(
            [predictions[i][submission_df["prob_pred"][i].argmax()]], 1
        )[0]
        submission_df.at[i, "after"] = pred
else:
    submission_df["after"] = ""

# Save to submission directory
submission_df.to_csv("./submission/submission.csv", index=False)
